messages:
Ava B: quick sync for Zenith deal. they want a short blurb and numbers for reserved GPUs + autoscale for SOW. traffic: baseline ~120 reqs/hr, spikes to ~1,800 reqs/hr for 20-30m, avg 100 tokens, p95 SLO 350ms for low-latency route.
Marcus T: baseline ~0.033 rps, spike ~0.5 rps. tiny absolute rps but concentrated bursts. recommend sizing for spike headroom not average.
Lina Q: quick recs: cost-optimized = 1 reserved GPU + spot burst (3); conservative = 2 reserved GPUs; HA = 2 reserved + 1 warm standby prewarmed.
Ava B: can you paste a tiny autoscale policy I can drop into SOW?
Infra Bot: paste (pseudo):
```
min_replicas: 1
recommended_reserved: 2
max_replicas: 6
scale_on: queued_requests
up_threshold: 120   # aggregated queued reqs
up_window: 180s
down_threshold: 25
down_window: 600s
burst_pool: spot
burst_max: 3
prewarm_seconds: 180
queue_cap: 200
reject_action: 429 + route_to_degraded
```
Marcus T: guardrails: use queued_requests trigger to catch sudden marketing blasts, prewarm top-25 prompts, set prewarm_ttl 15m. fallback to quantized model at >75% util.
Billing Bot: rough pricing lines: reserved A10-eq $6,500/mo -> 1 = $6.5k/mo list; 2 = $13k/mo. with 25% commit discount => ~$4.9k/mo and ~$9.75k/mo respectively. burst spots billed separately. note: token costs for spikes add variable usage.
Lina Q: security blurb to paste: "We support VPC Private Deployments and region/AZ pinning for dedicated pools. On AZ degradation we fail over to warm regional pools with automatic routing. For greater assurance recommend active-standby across two AZs and cross-AZ KV cache warmers. KMS integration and audit logs available."
Ava B: perfect. I'll include the three options + the short autoscale snippet and send SOW to Zenith. thanks :pray:
